claims.text: Baseline: the simulator reproduces the Viana-Bray transitions (6 of 6 within 95% CIs) and the melting of frozen camps under non-reciprocity (paper §4.1)
LLM response functions are not Ising-like: H1 9 of 12 (12 of 15, 15 of 18), H2 supported, H3 2 of 12, H4 not supported, H5 7 of 12 (paper §4.2)
Trait summaries fail live (surrogate 0 of 4); order-averaged tables succeed per step (K_avg |dP| <= 0.004) (paper §4.3-4.4)
Small per-step differences are amplified collectively (K_fixed vs K_live 3.4 SD from |dP| 0.002) (paper §4.4, §4.7.1)
Near a tipping point amplification exceeds controls: Stage B refuted; corrected Rule A 3 of 3 shapes for both models with a transition; GPT-4o-mini below floor (paper §4.7)
Whether a tipping point exists is model-dependent: two clear transitions, GPT-4o-mini none, Gemma unresolved (paper §4.8)
Residual persistence excess does not replicate (Stouffer Z = -0.42) (paper §4.5-4.6)
Exploratory probes on Gemma-4 activations (paper §4.2; no claim rests on them; full mode only)
Illustrations in figures/substack/ (not part of the analysis)
